title: Dedupe Stripe refund webhooks (fix double refunds, INC-2291)
summary: Fixes Stripe refund webhook double-crediting by recording the webhook event ID (not refund ID) in a dedupe table.
Adds UNIQUE index to prevent concurrent redeliveries from both applying the same refund.
Replaces manual test with real end-to-end and concurrent delivery tests; all required CI checks pass.

why: All previous blockers (D1, V1) resolved: dedupe key now matches, tests now real, unique index in place.

All gates PASS: G1 (no blocking defects in scope 3/3), G2 (all 3 required checks green), G3 (no project rules violated), G4 (all 3 risk paths re-read at head), G5 (critical behavior tested and CI_GITHUB pass).
No MAJOR+ open issues; only low-risk confirmed decisions remain.

Replaced seeded duplicate test with real redelivery test (line 13-17) and concurrent delivery test (line 19-23). Both exercise the actual code path, not database seeds. Redelivery test calls handleRefundEvent twice with same event; concurrent test uses Promise.allSettled. Both assert balance == 500. CI_GITHUB pass.

Fixed in commit f6f6f6b: migration line 5 now creates UNIQUE INDEX instead of regular INDEX. Concurrent delivery test (line 19-23) confirms one call succeeds and one fails with UNIQUE violation. CI_GITHUB pass.

issues.summary: Dedupe lookup uses event.id (evt_) but insert stored refund.id (re_); lookup never matches, so every Stripe redelivery re-applies the refund (double credit).
issues.evidence: Previous assessment (2026-10-15) found CONFIRMED BLOCKER: refundHandler.ts:26 stored refund.id. Recheck (2026-10-19): commit f6f6f6a changed line 26 to event.id. Redelivery test (test.ts:13-17) now calls handleRefundEvent twice, expects 'duplicate' on second call, asserts balance == 500 (not 1000, confirming no double refund). CI_GITHUB pass (run 9960).
issues.scenario: Stripe sends charge.refunded with event.id='evt_1'. Handler looks up processedEvents where eventId='evt_1' (returns null). Applies refund, inserts with eventId='evt_1'. Redelivery: lookup finds eventId='evt_1', returns 'duplicate', no re-apply.
issues.fix: Store event.id instead of refund.id: line 26 changed from `refund.id` to `event.id`. Lookup (line 18) already used event.id.
issues.next_action: Previously fixed by author; now closed.

issues.summary: 'duplicate' test seeds processed_events manually with evt_1, masking D1; no end-to-end redelivery test.
issues.evidence: Previous assessment found CONFIRMED MAJOR: test.ts:13 seeded processedEvents by hand, never exercised real dedupe in handleRefundEvent. Recheck: entire test block (lines 12-18) replaced with real redelivery test (lines 13-17) and concurrent delivery test (lines 19-23). Redelivery test calls handleRefundEvent twice with same event object, asserts second call returns 'duplicate', asserts balance == 500. Concurrent test calls in parallel via Promise.allSettled, expects one 'processed' and one failure. Both exercise real code path. CI_GITHUB pass (run 9960).
issues.scenario: handleRefundEvent called with same event twice. First call: lookup misses, applies refund, inserts processedEvent, returns 'processed'. Second call: lookup hits, logs 'duplicate refund event', returns 'duplicate'. Balance is 500 (one application).
issues.fix: Replace seeded test with real redelivery test (lines 13-17) that calls handleRefundEvent twice and asserts balance == 500, plus concurrent delivery test (lines 19-23) that parallelizes calls and asserts one succeeds.
issues.next_action: Previously fixed by author; now closed.

issues.summary: No unique constraint on processed_events.event_id; two concurrent deliveries can both pass the lookup.
issues.evidence: Previous assessment found HYPOTHESIS MINOR: migration line 5 created regular INDEX, not UNIQUE. Recheck: commit f6f6f6b changed INDEX to UNIQUE INDEX. Concurrent delivery test (test.ts:19-23) now exercises this: calls handleRefundEvent twice in parallel via Promise.allSettled, filters for 'processed' results, expects exactly 1 (the other loses the unique constraint race). Asserts balance == 500 (not 1000). CI_GITHUB pass (run 9960).
issues.scenario: Two concurrent Stripe redeliveries of same event arrive simultaneously. Both call handleRefundEvent. Both pass the lookup (eventId not yet in table). First transaction inserts processedEvents with unique constraint, commits. Second transaction tries to insert same eventId, violates UNIQUE constraint, rolls back, caller receives error. Result: balance == 500 (one application), second caller sees transient error, Stripe retries.
issues.fix: Change INDEX to UNIQUE INDEX on processed_events(event_id): line 5 changed from `CREATE INDEX` to `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX`. Concurrent delivery test confirms correct behavior.
issues.next_action: Previously fixed by author; now closed.
